# Mannequiny

Mannequiny by GDQuest, Luciano Muñoz, and contributors is licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The character comes from the Blender asset in [GDQuest's Mannequiny v0.2.0 release](https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-3d-mannequin/releases/tag/v0.2.0).

PCBS2 Coop adapted the original mesh and skin weights to a 45-bone deformation rig, normalized its height and orientation, converted it to FBX, adjusted the flat materials for HDRP, and authored carry, workbench, tool-table and monitor poses. The adapted character assets are available under CC BY 4.0. [Original Blender file](https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-3d-mannequin/releases/download/v0.2.0/mannequiny-0.3.0.blend)

The idle, walk, jog and sprint clips are from the [Universal Animation Library](https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html) by Quaternius, under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). PCBS2 Coop adapted the idle arm and hand curves for this rig.
